content: Iesu Rabob emon Imisir men
Sabat ra isawar gibunai, Mary Magdalene a Mary, James ayon, Salome mat on fio yanden ninibin on sitobon sitboai sitan Iesu usin sitimutai mes.
Sunday fomenei fomenei wera igegeg mom, osi sinai au rasi doguai nan.

Osi si’nan eta nenenai ato tous wat siyau bonen, “Iyafan arimon rasi dogu awanai agim inifiruruai weinet?” (On agim on gagamin bag.) Namon osi usos sitagai si’yeit on agim sit on ainau sifiruruai imatabir nono i’yen.
On mes osi rasi dogu amonai sirui, ato nan orot boboun sit beber kakakaiin wat iyot asumaiauai imair imama—ato osi on sit on engon siror.
On iyawures iyau, “Omi men woniror mes.” Yau asagob omi Iesu Nazareth emon nabai sikukubarai on wonunuen. On men nin-On rabob emon imisir men! Woit, On efan atonio nin siyein i’yen.
Omi ari atonio dura wonboai wonan On an baigibubunuotis wonkasones a Peter mat wonkasonai. ‘On ainau namui enan au Galilee; On arimon nan wonitai, On ato iyawurem on nanaba.’”
On mes osi rasi dogu emon sigat ato siber kwakwan nunuas yababan ibonues auman siyayai sinai. Osi men iyafan tani aurin sikakafun yabin osi siber kwakwan.
WASAGOBIN KANFOUN AN BAISAWARIN ATAMANIN
Iesu Irobotet Mary Magdalene aurin
[Sunday fomenei Iesu rabob emon imisir ato On ainau Mary Magdalene aurin irobotet, on jever min ainau Iesu dau engon nimtereban ruam on tefan emon ifaitanis sigat.
On inai baigibubunuotis ikasones. Osi siyababan sitotou;
ato osi Mary sitatam ikakafun i’yau on Iesu matanai bag it, On imisir men, ato osi men situtumai.
Iesu Irobotet Baigibubunuotis Ruam auris
On gibunai Iesu an baigibubunuotis ruam sibib si’nan au tafanam tani nan ato Iesu an Itin taniai nan auris irobotet.
Osi simatabir men ato sabu fani sikasones baise osi men situtum on.
Iesu An Baigibubunuotis Auyotoat Sasagin Kaita auris Irobotet

Gibui bag on Iesu an baigibubunuotis auyotoat sasagin kaita bayu si’yam nan auris irobotet. On igam iyawures yabin osi asi baitutum ambin mat osi nunuas wawanis on mes sabu fani Iesu yawasin sit siyawures on men situtumes.
On iyawures iyau, “Omi wonan au tafanam engonai ato wasagobin wonbino sabu engon tutufin auris.
Iyai iyafan ebitutum ato inbibapataito on arimon inyawas; iyai iyafan men initutum on arimon baimaki inboai.
Baitutumotis on arimon faiwar sinboai bobo buburis sinfouren: Osi Yau Wabiui arimon dau sinfaitanis singat; Osi arimon fafes sinikitabiren sabu touman fonasi sinikakafun;
Osi mota komasin sinboai a sareu sinbokatet auman sitoman on osi arimon men sinarab; osi imas sabu sawauis usisi sinyein on osi engon arimon sinyawas.”
Iesu Sibo Sigai au Safam
Bada Iesu an baigibubunuotis mat sikakafun isawar weie On au safam igai ato God an asumaiauai imair.

Baigibubunuotis sigat tafanam au engonai dura sibino, ato Bada an baibais mat siboen asi bino ikufaiwaren ato bobo buburis sifouren onai auris idura bag ato sabu engon situtum.] KANFOUN ATAMANIN AN BAISAWARIN TANI 9 [Jever sinai Peter tuturan mat auris ato mamaba orot rasi doguai ikakasones on engon sikasones. 10 On gibunai Iesu Toun an baigibubunuotis iyafares sigat tafanam au engonai dura kakafaiin a yawas mama wantoanin aurin on dura sibino.]
